title: ObserveOps-8.2.8 | Add Approval Notification Section for NCCM Request Approvals
description:
Acceptance Criteria:
 * In NCCM Request Approval, when a new approval request is generated, the user who has approval rights should receive a notification in the Alerts and Notifications (Bell icon)
 * The notification should be shown under Alerts and Notifications in a new section named: "Approval Notification"
 * The Approval Notification section should show the count of pending approval notifications, as shown in the attached Figma reference.
 * In the Approval Notification section, the approval user should be able to see the following details for each request:
 ** Request Name
 ** Requested By
 ** Timestamp
 ** Description
 ** Status
 * This enhancement will help approval users quickly identify and act on pending NCCM approval requests directly from the notification area.
